notes.title: 1.07 update! (September 6, 2025)
notes.notes:
VERSION 1.06 -> VERSION 1.07 Patch Notes

Made it so that the Deimos 2 encounter and Krakomaw requires more items for standard safety logic

Fixed issue with lava not draining correctly if the player teleports away after breaking the crystal at top-left Vulknor

Can no longer escape back out of Rok Rag room before the door closes (this could cause things to be in a state where the room is locked forever)

Some menu fixes

Some randomizer logic fixes

Added some randomizer settings sanity checks

Changed .nsf file names to match soundtrack names

Fixed a bug that causes copying seeds from old save files to copy the wrong settings

Made some cryptic stuff less cryptic

Made it so that an unopened warp gate couldn't be opened when it shouldn't be able to

notes.title: July 31st Update - Version 1.06
notes.notes:
VERSION 1.05 -> VERSION 1.06 Patch Notes

Added Safety options to the Randomizer that keep very difficult early situations out of logic. 

These are found in Other Settings when starting a Randomizer. (The Light setting is the equivalent of the older logic)

When using any setting other than Light, you will start in the central Guardia Tower less often when your starting location is set to Random.

These now default to being on in the Normal and Easy presets. The preset setting will need to be reselected for returning players.


Made Nav rooms not re-reveal unidentified items on the map
Some randomizer logic fixes.
Some fixes to the hidden area.
Some changes and bug fixes related to a hidden boss fight
Some fixes to the Deimos 3 encounter in randomizer
Fixed a crash that could happen when game overing in the Zenith Spike Gauntlet

notes.title: June 17th Update (Version 1.05)
notes.notes:
VERSION 1.04 -> VERSION 1.05 Patch Notes

Made warp gates not appear active on the big zoomed in map when not activated
Made some tiny tweaks to the Vallahar
Fixed some randomizer logic mistakes
Fixed some issues with the "Less intense palette"

notes.title: April 15th Update (Version 1.04)
notes.notes:
VERSION 1.03 -> VERSION 1.04 Patch Notes

Made warp gates marked on the map before activation
Fixed bugged steam achievement for Time Emperor
Retooled Tarazor fight a bit, mainly made getting them into the acid a bit easier
Made navigation room map reveals suggest going to a certain important, out of the way part of the map

notes.title: Patch notes for April 2nd (Also removing the third-party EULA)
notes.notes:
VERSION 1.02 -> VERSION 1.03 Patch Notes


 Fixed taking damage with magnus armor on certain spikes with assist damage set to 0
 Made the big hoppers near the top of Kresezoa respawn on game save instead of when slightly offscreen
 A modified the map in one place to make sequence breaking a bit less dangerous
 Added an option to hide aiming cones with mouse aiming
 A small tweak to Crysmoon to make a certain option clearer
 Made testing screens not show up on tiny map when selecting starting location for randomizer

Also, unconnected to the update, the big scary third-party EULA is gone now!

notes.title: 1.02 patch update (March 29, 2025)
notes.notes:
VERSION 1.01 -> VERSION 1.02 Patch Notes


 Made item names visible when item already obtained (the names of obtained items will be grey)
 Fixed rare graphical glitch related to Krakomaw grabbing you
 When rebinding keyboard controls, selecting the same key as what was already set clears the key
 Made Aesos health bar start off correctly
 Small map changes
 Made mouse wheel gun selection settable without the need to use the "Mouse Shot" preset
 Added reverse mouse wheel gun selection
 Shoulder gunner controller preset now doesn't have autofire with the right analog stick
 Aiming (without shooting) more visibly selectable for analog sticks
 Fixed a problem with randomizer settings strings not initializing properly when viewed in game
 Fixed UI issues with viewing randomizer settings in game

notes.title: March 22, 2025, Update Notes
notes.notes:
VERSION 1.00 -> VERSION 1.01 Patch Notes


 Replaced I-Frames assist option with a new Unlock Map assist option, that enables full view of the map at any time.
(Using assist options does NOT prevent unlocking achievements)

 Made grenades bounce a bit higher in the phantom fight.
 Made a small change to the spider area near phantom fight.
 Fixed it so that weird map tiles aren't revealed when completing a randomizer run.
 Corrected the ending credits roll to be more centered at the end.
